human_cases.requirement: Typography follows the supplied brand type guidance.
human_cases.pass_condition: Maison Serault / House stationery application (stationery.pdf): Typography follows the supplied brand type guidance.
human_cases.evidence_reference: A high contrast serif with genuine heritage credibility carries the house name. A quiet companion sets care copy and the address block. Type must never compete with the hairline foil mark.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when text is present. A style-only brand guide requires expert judgement; no exact font name is invented.

human_cases.requirement: Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.pass_condition: Maison Serault / House stationery application (stationery.pdf): Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.evidence_reference: The working files are gone. The wordmark survives only as one flat export from 2019 whose source files were never sent, a phone photograph of brushed brass letters on the boutique wall, and a daylight photograph of the monogram foil blocked on an old card. The three disagree about the house colour, and there is no vector master of either mark.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.
